note: Words that may not appear in any text a person can read, Details and About included: internal identifiers, protocol terms and implementation nouns for this product. Matched as whole words; `terms` ignore case, `exact` match case (use it for codes and capitalised names). Song2Vid's list comes from GLOSSARY.md (the words each term says to avoid), the command's keys and error codes (SPEC 14.5, 14.6, 24.5, 24.6), the Encoder values and names (SPEC 24.2), and the starter's own list. Codes that are also plain English (usage, network, cancelled) are not listed; `software` is not listed because "software encoder" is the page's own name for one Encoder. About shows FFmpeg's notice (SPEC 26.2, 27.8), which names FFmpeg: the screen that shows that text must carry it so the audit can leave it out, and S2V-030 records how in docs/DECISIONS.md. Developer text reaches a person only through Copy Details, which copies it without showing it.
